name: Coca-Cola Classic
claims: The world's most recognized beverage. Iconic taste that has not changed since 1985. Unmatched brand equity and consumer nostalgia. Universal menu and venue fit.
target: General consumers, restaurants, stadiums, convenience stores, airlines, movie theaters

name: Coca-Cola Zero Sugar
claims: Full Coca-Cola taste with zero sugar. Fastest-growing cola SKU. Appeals to health-conscious consumers without sacrificing brand recognition.
target: Health-conscious consumers, hospitals, universities, airlines, restaurants

name: Diet Coke
claims: Distinct lighter taste. Decades of brand loyalty especially among women 25-45. Different flavor profile from Zero Sugar — not a substitute.
target: Loyal diet soda drinkers, restaurants, general consumers

name: Sprite
claims: Number one lemon-lime soda globally. Strong hip-hop and youth culture brand presence. Clean crisp taste with broad demographic appeal.
target: General consumers, restaurants, fast food chains, sporting venues, universities

name: Fanta
claims: Wide variety of fruit flavors. Playful, youthful brand identity. Strong international recognition. Drives incremental purchases in venues with diverse audiences.
target: Younger consumers, theme parks, movie theaters, international audiences

name: Powerade
claims: ION4 electrolyte formula. Official sports drink of the NCAA and multiple Olympics. Value-priced vs Gatorade. Available in broad flavor range.
target: Athletes, sporting venues, universities, gyms, schools

name: Smartwater
claims: Vapor-distilled premium water with electrolytes. Aspirational, clean aesthetic. Celebrity associations. Premium price point drives revenue per unit.
target: Health-conscious consumers, airlines, hotels, gyms, hospitals, convenience stores

name: Dasani
claims: Purified water with minerals added for taste. Broad availability and competitive price point. Reliable volume driver for venues needing an affordable water option.
target: Sporting venues, convenience stores, restaurants, hospitals, general consumers

name: Minute Maid
claims: Most trusted juice brand in the US. Wide portfolio including OJ, lemonade, fruit punch, and juice boxes. Strong in family and institutional settings.
target: Hospitals, airlines, universities, restaurants, movie theaters, families

name: Gold Peak Tea
claims: Brewed tea taste in a bottle. Homestyle positioning. Fastest-growing RTD tea brand in the US. Available in sweet, unsweet, green, and diet varieties.
target: General consumers, restaurants, convenience stores, hospitals

name: Fairlife
claims: Ultra-filtered milk with 50% more protein and 50% less sugar than regular milk. Lactose-free. Premium price point. Fast-growing in health and fitness channels.
target: Health-conscious consumers, hospitals, universities, gyms, airlines

name: Topo Chico
claims: Cult-favorite sparkling mineral water from Mexico. Premium on-premise positioning. Strong with cocktail culture and upscale restaurant accounts. Authentic heritage story.
target: Upscale restaurants, bars, hotels, health-conscious consumers

name: Simply Orange
claims: Not-from-concentrate premium OJ. Clean label, no preservatives. Refrigerated positioning commands higher shelf presence and price point.
target: Upscale restaurants, hotels, airlines, hospitals, health-conscious consumers

name: Honest Tea
claims: Organic, low-sugar RTD tea. Appeals to health-conscious and sustainability-minded consumers. B Corp heritage. Strong in natural and specialty retail.
target: Health-conscious consumers, hospitals, universities, natural food buyers
